title: Measured value with TESTFR handshake
purpose: Increase direction and parser diversity by combining a U-format test frame with a compact monitoring-direction measured-value ASDU returned from server to client.
expected_behavior: Peer processes TESTFR activation at link level and then parses a monitoring ASDU carrying one short floating-point measured value without crash.
constraints_preserved: First frame uses IEC 60870-5-104 U-format with 4-byte APCI and correct 0x68 length 0x04
Second frame uses documented TypeID 13 M_ME_NC_1
Second frame length 0x11 matches 4 APCI bytes plus 13 ASDU bytes
Monitoring ASDU uses one object, 3-byte IOA, 4-byte float value, and 1-byte quality descriptor in conservative common ordering
issue_safety_notes: Safe structural analogue adds parser depth and reverse direction coverage while remaining far from the exact crashing issue payload.
